title: Power
content: The rate of doing work is defined as power[cite: 1].

title: Mechanical Advantage
content: The ratio of load to effort is defined as the mechanical advantage of the machine[cite: 1].

title: Velocity Ratio
content: The ratio of the distance moved by the effort to that of the load in the same time is called the velocity ratio of the machine[cite: 1].

title: Efficiency
content: The ratio of output work to input work is defined as the efficiency of the machine[cite: 1].

title: Elasticity
content: Ability to retain the original form when the applied force is removed is called elasticity[cite: 1].

title: Hooke's Law
content: As long as the elastic limit of a body is not exceeded, the strain produced is proportional to stress causing it[cite: 1].
